desc:
CHEWY GRANOLA BARS: Positively bursting with savory peanuts and sweet granola; A must-have for an on-the-go snack or in a lunch box

SWEET AND SALTY: Nature Valley Sweet and Salty Nut Bars provides a perfect balance of savory nuts and sweet granola

PERFECTLY PORTABLE: Easy bars for snack time or an on-the-go invigorating treat; Perfect for the pantry, lunch box, and hiking trail

TASTY SNACK: No artificial flavors, artificial colors, or high fructose corn syrup

CONTAINS: One 7.2 oz box of Nature Valley Peanut Sweet and Salty Nut Granola Bars; 6 bars
features:
Features & Benefits

1. Perfect Sweet‑and‑Salty Combo

Bursting with roasted peanuts and coated in creamy peanut (and sometimes almond) butter — balancing savory and sweet flavors in every bite.

2. Chewy, Adventure‑Ready Snack

Designed to be portable and satisfying, ideal for lunch boxes, on‑the‑go moments, office breaks, or hiking fuel.

3. No Artificial Fillers

Made without artificial flavors, colors, or high‑fructose corn syrup — just real ingredients like whole‑grain oats, peanuts, and natural sweeteners.

4. Whole Grains & Peanuts

Contain whole‑grain oats and real roasted peanuts, offering a source of fiber and plant‑based protein.

5. Moderate Nutritional Profile

A single bar (approx. 34g) delivers:

160 kcal

8g fat (2.5 g saturated)

20 g carbs, including 7 g total sugar (of which ~7 g are added sugars)

3 g protein, 1 g fiber, and 140 mg sodium

6. Allergen Alert

Contains peanuts, almond, milk, and soy — made in facilities using tree nuts.

7. Recyclable Packaging & Brand Ethics

Nature Valley supports sustainability (e.g., recyclable wrappers) and school reward programs like Box Tops.
ingredients: Roasted Peanuts, Corn Syrup, Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Rice Flour, Palm Kernel Oil, Vegetable Glycerin, Peanut Butter (peanuts, salt), Fructose, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Whey, Soy Lecithin, Salt, Peanut Flour, Corn Starch, Barley Malt Extract, Honey Roasted Almond Butter (almonds, honey, maltodextrin, palm oil, mixed tocopherols), Baking Soda, Natural Flavor, Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Retain Freshness.
